dedupe_keys.name: gisc dwd de drought and low flow datasets

description: gisc.dwd.de: drought and low-flow datasets is a collection of datasets listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gisc.dwd.de. Coverage: the area served by gisc.dwd.de. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about drought and low-flow; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Monatlicher DWD-Dürreindex: Netzdaten; Anomalien des monatlichen DWD-Dürreindex: Netzdaten; DWD Dürreindex; Anomalien des monatlichen DWD-Dürreindex: Landkarten. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
